title: Live Streaming content at scale using Amazon CloudFront
description: Create MediaPackage custom endpoints as origins for a CloudFront distribution.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern demonstrates how to create MediaPackage custom endpoints as the Origins for a CloudFront distribution to enable the live stream content to be delivered globally and at scale.
